name: nafems_le1
source: NAFEMS TNSB Rev.3 LE1 elliptic membrane (plane stress). Quarter annulus, SAME planform as LE10: outer ellipse (3.25,2.75) m, inner (2.0,1.0) m — scaled x10 to mm, thickness 2 mm. Uniform outward tension p=10 MPa on the outer edge BC (manual_loads negative pressure on exposed +x/+y facets of the rim band). Symmetry: ux=0 on the x=0 cut (AB), uy=0 on the y=0 cut (DC) as exact node-plane pins, mid-plane uz=0 approximates plane stress. Reference sigma_yy at D=(2000,0) = 92.7 MPa; fino (quad9) and sparselizard (AMR) both land at 92.69.
notes: Resultants: Rx = p*t*bo = 10*2*27.5 = 550 N, Ry = p*t*ao = 650 N. stress_near probes the inner-edge peak in a 2 mm ball — a single cell-centre sample under-reads at coarse pitch and the staircase rim overshoots at mid refinement (59.8 -> 79.3 -> 101.2 -> 95.7, converging to ~92.7).
